_readme: Job sources for the weekly updater. Set enabled:true/false. Keys go in GitHub Secrets, never in this file. Lower priority number = preferred listing when duplicates are merged (employer sites beat aggregators). See README section 'Add or remove job sources'.

settings.scheduleDescription: Mondays at 10:00 UTC (6:00 am Toronto in summer, 5:00 am in winter)
settings.userAgent: GTA-Job-Dashboard/1.0 (personal weekly job digest; respects robots.txt)

sources.name: Adzuna (aggregates Canadian job boards and employer sites)
sources._setup: Free key at developer.adzuna.com. Add GitHub secrets ADZUNA_APP_ID and ADZUNA_APP_KEY.

sources.name: Jooble (aggregates Canadian job boards)
sources._setup: Free key at jooble.org/api/about. Add GitHub secret JOOBLE_API_KEY.

sources.name: Employer careers (Workday) — replace with a real employer
sources._setup: Open the employer's careers page. If the URL looks like https://acme.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/AcmeCareers, then host=acme.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com, tenant=acme, site=AcmeCareers. Copy this block once per employer.

sources.name: Employer careers (Greenhouse) — replace with a real employer
sources._setup: If jobs are at boards.greenhouse.io/acme, board=acme. Official public API.

sources.name: Employer careers (Lever) — replace with a real employer
sources._setup: If jobs are at jobs.lever.co/acme, site=acme. Official public API.

sources.name: Employer careers (SmartRecruiters) — replace with a real employer
sources._setup: If jobs are at jobs.smartrecruiters.com/Acme, companyIdentifier=Acme. Official public API.

sources.name: Any RSS job feed — paste a feed URL
sources._setup: Use for employer or public-sector careers pages that publish an RSS feed (look for an RSS icon or 'Subscribe' link).

sources.name: Employer job pages with structured data (schema.org JobPosting)
sources._setup: Many career pages embed machine-readable JobPosting data for Google Jobs. The updater reads it only where robots.txt allows.
